release_notes:
RJD PisoWiFi System v3.14.42 - Strict Category-Level License Activation & Feature Locking

🛡️ Module-Level License Enforcement
- piso_wifi key (RJD-PISO-) activates ONLY PisoWiFi Vendo System features
- Phone Rental System (RJD-RENT-), NodeMCU Sub-Vendos (RJD-MCU-), and MikroTik Integration (RJD-MIKRO-) remain strictly locked with activation prompt unless their dedicated category keys are active
- Added /api/license/status feature flags API and UI feature lock cards
